text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer! Looks like you're 
giving it your all every single day.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how much your trainee has grown is 
wonderful, of course, but as someone who 
has watched over you ever since you first 
arrived at the academy as a rookie――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Your own growth has been remarkable as 
well, Trainer. It truly warms my heart♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Though it is strictly in my capacity as 
the Chairwoman's secretary, please allow 
me to continue watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I truly look forward to your 
continued success!
